summary: Iteration 6: Referral system (FRIEND15), PayPal confirm endpoint, and gym-energy slug fixes. All 23 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend store ebooks fixed (GymEnergy cover now renders). Share score modal shows referral promotion. One minor UI bug found and fixed in StoreEbooksPage.tsx.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: Tropical Gym Energy Recipes book showed emoji fallback (📚) instead of custom GymEnergyBookCover SVG. Root cause: BookCover checked `slug === 'gym-energy'` but products.ts uses slug `gym-energy-recipes`. Fix applied: changed to `slug === 'gym-energy' || slug === 'gym-energy-recipes'` (same fix that was applied in ProductDetailPage.tsx).

passed_tests: POST /api/referral/generate deterministic — same email always same ref_code
POST /api/checkout/create-order with FRIEND15 → discount_pct=15, final_price = original * 0.85
POST /api/game/leaderboard with email → score submitted, appears on leaderboard
Frontend store ebooks page loads with Tropical Nutrition Series section
All 4 series book covers render correctly with custom SVG components (after fix)
Classic Collection section loads with filter tabs working
Game page /fruit-game loads and plays correctly
Game over screen shows Final Score, Share button, Play Again button
Share modal opens with score card, share buttons, and referral promotion text
Share modal shows 'Subscribe to unlock your personal referral link + 15% off' (when no email provided)
critical_code_review_comments: StoreEbooksPage.tsx BookCover function had slug mismatch: checked 'gym-energy' but products.ts slug is 'gym-energy-recipes'. FIXED in this iteration.

The referral section in ShareScoreModal only shows the full referral link when playerEmail is provided (set via email capture during gameplay). Without email, it shows the 'Subscribe to unlock' message. This is correct by design but users need to provide email during gameplay to see the full referral section.

Backend /api/subscribe: When a user with existing email re-subscribes with a referral code, it returns discount_code=FRIEND15 even though they are already subscribed (already_subscribed status). This could be intentional but may result in the existing subscriber not being aware they were already subscribed with a different discount.

rca_of_gym_energy_bug.root_cause: The BookCover function (local to StoreEbooksPage.tsx) used exact slug check `if (slug === 'gym-energy')` but the frontend products.ts data uses slug `gym-energy-recipes`. SERIES_SLUGS set correctly uses 'gym-energy-recipes'. ProductDetailPage.tsx was already updated to handle both slugs but the same fix was not applied to StoreEbooksPage.tsx's local BookCover function.
rca_of_gym_energy_bug.fix_applied: Changed line 30 in StoreEbooksPage.tsx from `if (slug === 'gym-energy')` to `if (slug === 'gym-energy' || slug === 'gym-energy-recipes')`
